components.summary: Pastes clipboard media from the Markdown editor webview: validates range and media, has ResourcePasteOrDropProvider copy the files into the workspace (reading their bytes from the webview in chunks), then applies the snippet edit at the pasted range.

components.summary: Completions and diagnostics for the Markdown editor webview: requests vscode.executeCompletionItemProvider at the mirrored position, filters by the typed prefix, and on accept re-resolves the item, refuses snippets and changed lists, and applies the edit.

diagnostics.description: vscode.languages.getDiagnostics for the document: {start, end_exclusive, message, severity 0-3}

components.name: markdownEditorMediaTransfer (readClipboardMediaContents)

components.name: MarkdownEditorNavigation
components.summary: The CustomTextEditorNavigation of a Markdown editor: mirrors the webview selection as a vscode.Selection (latest request, current epoch only) and reveals ranges in the webview after checking the document version, generation and epoch are still current.

components.name: MarkdownEditorProvider
components.summary: The 'vscode.markdown.editor' custom text editor: resolves an editor (trust prompt, authenticated webview, local resource roots), serves the webview's markdown.editor.host RPC (ready, edit, openLink, rename, completions, media paste, selection, rich links) against the authoritative document, and forwards markdown.editor.* commands to the active editor's renderer.

editor.description: the one resolved editor of this model: document mirror (text, version) and the #wireSingle closure state (webviewText, readonly, ready)

readonly_default.description: the markdown.editor.readonly memento (global default for the next editor)

components.name: MarkdownEditorRename
components.summary: Rename from the Markdown editor: one session per request id, prepared against a (version, editEpoch) snapshot with vscode.prepareRename, applied with vscode.executeDocumentRenameProvider and workspace.applyEdit only while nothing changed.

components.name: MarkdownEditorRichLinkController
components.summary: Keeps the webview's rich link subscriptions: resolves each href (git commit hints, absolute URIs, then the Markdown link resolver), finds a matching link presentation rule and publishes the watcher's presentation, or undefined.

components.name: MarkdownEditorRpcTransport
components.summary: The authenticated message transport of one webview generation: drops envelopes for another channel or secret, rejects malformed JSON-RPC, buffers messages until a listener is set, and refuses to send once disposed (responses are silently dropped).

interfaces.name: on-before-shutdown
interfaces.summary: The before-shutdown handshake (seam). The main process asks via vscode:onBeforeUnload; the service fires onBeforeShutdown (subscribers veto through lifecycle-service.veto), then, only when nobody vetoed, the final-veto phase (topic lifecycle-service.on-before-shutdown-final). Returns veto, which the window sends back on the cancel or ok channel. Subscribers declare subscribe: [lifecycle-service.on-before-shutdown].

then.title: Four or more clicks select all
Triple click selects the line (_lineSelect, or the drag / last-cursor variants)
Double click with the multi-cursor modifier selects a word for a new last cursor
Double click while dragging extends by words (_wordSelectDrag)
_trySelectBracketContent: right after an opening bracket, matchBracket finds its closing partner
_trySelectBracketContent: right before a closing bracket, matchBracket finds its opening partner
The selection runs from the end of the opening bracket to the start of the closing one
A bracket block was found, select it (_select)
No block next to the click, so select the word (_wordSelect)
Single click with the multi-cursor modifier adds a cursor (_createCursor)

configs.summary: Code constant: unexpected agent host exits restart immediately until 5 restarts, then the manager gives up.
Code default: the standalone agent host server listens on --port, else VSCODE_AGENT_HOST_PORT, else 8081.
Code constant: graceful shutdown before an explicit restart or quit is raced against 6 s.
Code constant: the worktree cleanup service runs a pass every 5 minutes (3 s debounce, 30 s..1 h backoff).
agents.voice.enabled (owner chat): the Voice Mode panel and the voice bridge commands.
Code constant: protocol baselines a host accepts (caret-compatible), plus the legacy 0.10.0 alias; the host speaks PROTOCOL_VERSION 1.1.0.
The agent debug file-logging flag that gates /troubleshoot; deployed = default.
chat.agent.enabled: agent mode can be used (policy ChatAgentMode can force false); product.json sets no override, so deployed = default.
chat.agentHost.claudeAgent.enabled: lets the agent host register the Claude harness (passed to the host as an env var; the SDK must also be available).
chat.agentHost.cloudSandbox.enabled (reference; registered by chat).

chat.agentHost.codexAgent.enabled: default is product.quality !== 'stable'. product.json of this OSS build sets no quality, so the deployed value is true. The code default is the expression quality !== 'stable', recorded as false (its Stable value).
chat.agentMerge.addressReviews: Agent Merge may address review threads (global default for sessions).
chat.agentMerge.fixCI: Agent Merge may fix failed required CI checks.
chat.agentMerge.mergePullRequest: always, ifUnchanged or never.
chat.agentMerge.resolveConflicts: Agent Merge may update branches or resolve conflicts.
chat.agentSessions.appearanceTools.enabled: whether the set-chat-background tool is registered. product.json does not override it.
chat.agentSessions.backgroundImageTint: tint the theme from the chat background image. product.json does not override it.
chat.agentSessions.sessionStorageCleanupSuggestion.enabled: check worktree disk space and suggest cleaning up session storage. product.json does not override it.
chat.artifactIntegrations.enabled: Agent Merge commands refuse while artifact integrations are on.
chat.automations.enabled: automation commands show "automations disabled" unless true (reference; registered by chat).
chat.disableAIFeatures (ChatAIDisabledSettingId); triggerSetup writes false.
chat.editing.confirmEditRequestRemoval: confirm before removing a request and its edits; deployed = default.
chat.editing.confirmEditRequestRetry: confirm before retrying a request and undoing its edits; deployed = default.
chat.experimental.sessionArchiveActionWording (owner chat): archive (Archive/Unarchive) or done (Mark as Done/Restore).
chat.inlineChat.agentHost.enabled: back inline chat with the agent host; deployed = default (experiment-controlled at startup).
chat.mcp.access: none, registry or all (policy ChatMCP can override). product.json does not override it.
chat.mcp.apps.enabled: whether MCP tool invocations may carry custom UI (mcpAppData).
chat.mcp.autostart: which MCP servers start automatically when a chat message is submitted (never, onlyNew, newAndOutdated). product.json does not override it.

chat.mcp.serverSampling: per-server sampling permissions keyed "<collection label>: <server label>". No top-level default; the per-entry schema defaults (allowedDuringChat true, allowedOutsideChat false) are not applied when a server has no entry, so the code sees undefined and prompts.
chat.remoteAgentHosts: WebSocket remote agent host entries ({address, name, connectionToken}). product.json does not override it.
chat.remoteAgentHostsEnabled (owner chat): enable connecting to remote agent hosts.
chat.tools.eligibleForAutoApproval: tools set to false always ask; deployed = default.
chat.tools.global.autoApprove ('YOLO mode'); product.json sets no override, so deployed = default.
Allow breakpoints in any file. No product.json override.
Confirm closing the window while debugging. No product.json override.
Code constant: on shutdown with an error the adapter is probably gone, so disconnect waits only 200 ms (2000 ms otherwise).
Code constant: the disconnect request waits 2000 ms (200 ms after an adapter error).
What to do when the preLaunchTask has errors (debugAnyway | showErrors | prompt | abort). No product.json override.
When the Run and Debug view opens. No product.json override.
Which editors to save before starting a debug session. No product.json override.
product.json editSessions.store.url. The OSS product.json has no editSessions.store, so the deployed value is empty and EditSessionsContribution registers no actions.
editor.accessibilitySupport (editor option; registered by the editor area, read here by a toggle command).
editor.codeActionsOnSave (object form; array form also accepted). Default {} means no code actions run on save.
editor.columnSelection (editor option; registered by the editor area, read here by a toggle command).
editor.defaultFormatter: extension id of the default formatter; null (unset) by default, modeled as the empty string.

editor.doubleClickSelectsBlock: a double-click right after an opening bracket (or before a closing one) selects the content inside instead of the word. No product.json override, so deployed = default.
editor.folding: folding enabled (CONTEXT_FOLDING_ENABLED is the folding commands' precondition)
editor.foldingStrategy: auto (providers, else indentation) | indentation
editor.formatOnSave. The registration has no default, so the configuration service returns undefined, read as false. Read by the editor area's format-on-save participant.
editor.formatOnSaveMode
editor.gotoLocation.multipleDefinitions: peek | gotoAndPeek | goto (EditorGoToLocation defaults, registered through editorConfigurationSchema)
editor.gotoLocation.multipleReferences
editor.hover.enabled: on | off | onKeyboardModifier; gates mouse-move hovers
editor.minimap.enabled (editor option; registered by the editor area, read here by a toggle command).
editor.multiCursorModifier (editor option; registered by the editor area, read here by a toggle command).
editor.rename.enablePreview: offer a refactor preview when a preview handler exists
editor.renderControlCharacters (editor option; registered by the editor area, read here by a toggle command).
editor.renderWhitespace (editor option; registered by the editor area, read here by a toggle command).
editor.suggestSelection: first | recentlyUsed | recentlyUsedByPrefix (SuggestMemoryService strategy)
emmet.excludeLanguages - languages where emmet abbreviations are neither expanded nor suggested.
emmet.includeLanguages - extra language id to emmet-supported language mappings.
emmet.showExpandedAbbreviation - never, always or inMarkupAndStylesheetFilesOnly (no suggestions in mapped languages or jsx).
emmet.syntaxProfiles - per-syntax output profiles (selfClosingStyle decides how splitJoinTag joins a tag).
emmet.triggerExpansionOnTab - Tab expands abbreviations; when nothing expands the tab command runs instead.
environmentService.isBuilt: true unless VSCODE_DEV is set (running out of sources). Gates signature enforcement and the server's unauthorized-client refusal.
Code constant: the Eventually lifecycle phase starts 2.5 s after window open (then on idle, at most 2.5 s more).
explorer.confirmDelete: ask before deleting from the explorer.

extensions.allowed (policy AllowedExtensions). Declared type object, code default the string '*'. Any non-object value, or exactly {'*': true}, allows everything. Otherwise an object keyed by extension id or publisher (lower-cased) whose values are true, false, 'stable' or a list of versions ('1.2.3' or '1.2.3@linux-x64'). Deployed = default.
extensions.autoCheckUpdates: check the gallery for updates periodically
extensions.autoUpdate: 'on' or 'off' (code maps legacy true/onlyEnabledExtensions to 'on' and false/onlySelectedExtensions to 'off'). product.json does not override it.
extensions.autoUpdateDelay in hours: a published update is auto-installed only after this delay (not for product-trusted publishers)
extensions.confirmedUriHandlerExtensionIds: extensions whose URIs open without the confirmation dialog.
ExtensionsDownloader retries a failed VSIX or signature download twice (three attempts)
extensions.experimental.agentsWindowManagement: default is product.quality !== 'stable'; product.json sets no quality in a build from source, so true.
extensions.experimental.deferredStartupFinishedActivation: when true, onStartupFinished activations are batched in 50 ms setTimeout0 slices instead of all at once.
product.json extensionsGallery.serviceUrl. The OSS product.json has none, so IExtensionGalleryService.isEnabled() is false and marketplace theme browsing returns at once.
extensions.requestTimeout in ms for Marketplace HTTP requests
extensions.supportNodeGlobalNavigator. When true the remote extension host is forked with --supportGlobalNavigator. Deployed = default.
ExtensionsWorkbenchService.UpdatesCheckInterval: 12 hours between update checks (1 hour on insider with a pending product update)
extensions.verifySignature (native only): verify gallery packages are signed before install

extensions.webWorker: 'auto' makes the desktop web worker extension host LazyAutoStart (created only when a web extension needs it); true starts it eagerly; false never. product.json sets no override, so deployed = default.
Code constant: the 'extension host terminated unexpectedly. Restarting...' status message hides after 5 s.
Code constant: ExtensionHostCrashTracker._CRASH_LIMIT. Auto-restart only while fewer than 3 crashes are recorded in the window.
Code constant: ExtensionHostCrashTracker._TIME_LIMIT (5 minutes); older crashes are forgotten.
Code constant: onStartupFinished activation starts when eager ('*', workspaceContains, resolver) activation finishes or after 10 s, whichever is first.
Code constant (no setting): the local extension host must connect, send Ready and then Initialized, each within 60 s, or start() rejects.
files.autoSave. Desktop default is off; the same registration defaults to afterDelay on web (isWeb) and in the agents window (agentsWindow.default). product.json does not override it.
files.autoSaveDelay in ms; a delay <= 1000 counts as a short auto save delay (FilesConfigurationService.DEFAULT_AUTO_SAVE_DELAY).

files.eol: \n | \r\n | auto (the OS end of line). No product.json override, so deployed = default. A new text file model records the resolved EOL; the editor's ModelService applies it to new text models.
files.hotExit: off | onExit | onExitAndWindowClose. product.json sets no override, so the deployed value is the registered native default.
files.insertFinalNewline, read by FinalNewLineParticipant.
files.participants.timeout in ms for create/rename/delete participants; 0 or less disables them.
files.refactoring.autoSave: save files touched by a multi-file refactoring when the caller asks to respect it.
files.saveConflictResolution: askUser keeps the etag check on save; overwriteFileOnDisk disables it.
files.trimFinalNewlines, read by TrimFinalNewLinesParticipant.
files.trimTrailingWhitespace, read by TrimWhitespaceParticipant. No product.json override, so deployed = default.
editor.formatOnSaveMode: file | modifications | modificationsIfAvailable. Registered in files.contribution.ts, read only by FormatOnSaveParticipant. No product.json override, so deployed = default.
git.allowNoVerifyCommit
git.autoRepositoryDetection (true, false, subFolders or openEditors)
git.autorefresh
git.enableSmartCommit
git.enabled. Extension settings come from contributes.configuration; product.json does not override them.
git.ignoreMissingGitWarning
git.openAfterClone (always, alwaysNewWindow, whenNoFolderOpen, prompt)
git.openRepositoryInParentFolders
git.optimisticUpdate
git.requireGitUserConfig (adds -c user.useConfigOnly=true)
git.smartCommitChanges
git.statusLimit (entries)
git.suggestSmartCommit
git.timeline.date, which commit date (committed or authored) orders the timeline
git.untrackedChanges
git.useEditorAsCommitInput: with an empty input box the commit opens the git editor instead of an input box
git.useIntegratedAskPass, whether git processes authenticate through VS Code's askpass handler
git.worktreeIncludeFiles, .gitignore-style patterns of ignored files copied into a new worktree
github-authentication.preferDeviceCodeFlow. Extension settings come from contributes.configuration; product.json does not override it.
github-enterprise.uri, the deprecated single-instance setting (no default, so unset; modeled as '').
github-enterprise.uris (no default in package.json, so unset; modeled as an empty list).
interactiveWindow.promptToSaveOnClose: when false, interactive notebooks are scratchpads (never dirty).
js/ts.experimental.useTsgo (falls back to typescript.experimental.useTsgo)
js/ts.implementationsCodeLens.enabled; the implementations code lens shows only when true.
js/ts.implementationsCodeLens.showOnAllClassMethods; on adds the implementations lens to every non-private class method.
js/ts.implementationsCodeLens.showOnInterfaceMethods; on adds the implementations lens to interface methods.
js/ts.referencesCodeLens.enabled; the references code lens is registered only once this is modified and shows only when true.
js/ts.referencesCodeLens.showOnAllFunctions; on shows the references lens on every function, not only exported ones.
js/ts.suggest.autoImports; off drops entries that carry an auto-import action.
js/ts.suggest.completeFunctionCalls; on completes functions with their parameter signature.
js/ts.suggest.enabled (falls back to typescript.suggest.enabled); off disables TS completions.
js/ts.suggest.jsdoc.enabled (falls back to typescript.suggest.completeJSDocs); off disables the /** */ completion.
js/ts.suggest.names; off drops 'warning' (name) completion entries.
js/ts.suggest.paths; off drops directory, script and external module name entries.
js/ts.tsserver.log (falls back to typescript.tsserver.log)
js/ts.tsserver.useSyntaxServer (falls back to typescript.tsserver.useSyntaxServer)
Code constant: LifecycleMainService.kill waits at most 1 s for windows to close before app.exit.
markdown.copyFiles.destination: glob of the Markdown document -> destination (with ${fileName}-style variables) for pasted or dropped files; unset means next to the document.
markdown.copyFiles.overwriteBehavior: overwrite an existing file, or pick name-1, name-2 ... (nameIncrementally).
markdown.editor.quickSuggestions: automatic (as-you-type) suggestions in the Markdown editor; off by default, so automatic requests answer an empty list.
markdown.links.openLocation: where a followed Markdown link opens (currentGroup or beside).
Code constant: the gateway tool broker waits up to 5 s for a server to become ready before answering from cache.
network.meteredConnection: auto | on | off (APPLICATION scope). Registered by platform-core; read here by MeteredConnectionMainService. Not overridden in product.json.
notebook.backup.sizeLimit in KB; backups of notebooks with more output bytes than this fail.
notebook.confirmDeleteRunningCell: ask before deleting an executing cell.

notebook.experimental.remoteSave. The registered default is `product.quality` set and not 'stable'; this build's product.json (Code - OSS) has no quality key, so both evaluate to false and saves go through the snapshot path.
notebook.formatOnCellExecution: format cells before running them.
npm.packageManager (auto, npm, yarn, pnpm, bun); auto detects it from the lockfiles
Code constant: OnboardingTryoutHandoff waits at most 30 s for the Agents window to accept a feature example, then cancels it.
Code constant PollingConsts.ExtendedPollingMaxDuration: an extended idle wait gives up after 2 min.
Code constant PollingConsts.FirstPollingMaxDuration: the first idle wait gives up (Timeout) after 20 s.
Code constant PollingConsts.MaxPollingIntervalDuration: the poll interval stops doubling at 10 s.
Code constant PollingConsts.MinIdleEvents: two polls without new data mean the terminal is idle.
Code constant PollingConsts.MinPollingDuration: the first OutputMonitor poll interval; it doubles up to 10 s.
php.validate.enable
php.validate.executablePath (null by default, then php is looked up on PATH); empty means unset
php.validate.run (onSave or onType)
product.json builtInExtensionsEnabledWithAutoUpdates: built-ins that may be installed/updated from the gallery

product.json configurationSync.store.url. Absent in the OSS product.json, so the sync store is undefined, settings sync is Uninitialized and its commands are never registered. Scenarios set a URL to model a sync-enabled build.

product.json extensionsGallery.serviceUrl. The OSS product.json built from this commit has no extensionsGallery, so the gallery manifest is Unavailable and every gallery operation refuses. Scenarios set a URL to model a Marketplace-enabled build.
product.json quality (absent in the OSS product.json): the update channel; no quality means updates are disabled.
product.json tunnelApplicationName: when set, `code tunnel|serve-web|agent` spawn the Rust CLI.
product.json updateUrl. The OSS product.json at this commit has no updateUrl (and no quality), so the update service disables itself with MissingConfiguration.
Code constant (not a setting): the pty host fires a heartbeat every 5000 ms.
Code constant: first wait after the pty host (re)starts before warning about a missing heartbeat.
Code constant: BeatInterval 5000 x FirstWaitMultiplier 1.2 = 6000 ms before the warning timer.
Code constant: BeatInterval 5000 x SecondWaitMultiplier 1 = 5000 ms before the pty host is declared unresponsive.
Code constant: the main process restarts a crashed pty host while restartCount <= 5.
Code constant: the pty host waits up to 4000 ms for a window to claim a process before treating it as an orphan.
Code constant passed by the main process (app.ts) as VSCODE_RECONNECT_GRACE_TIME: a detached persistent process is killed after 60 s without reconnect.
Code constant: shortened grace time once a window has reconnected (reduceConnectionGraceTime).
DISCONNECT_PROMPT_TIME: the reconnect progress is shown when no data arrived for 40 s
The client waits at most 10 s for the server's sign request during the handshake
createInitialConnection tries 5 times before a permanent failure
